engine.measurement_policy: voice-quality metrics restricted to sustained voiced notes; deterministic scoring rubric v5

stem_separation.separator_license: UNVERIFIED — non-default model, confirm commercial license

pitch.range_semitones_note: Robust range (2.5th-97.5th percentile of voiced frames). Immune to single octave-error frames.

voice_quality.cpps_note: Cepstral Peak Prominence (smoothed, Praat). Research-standard clarity measure. SCORED: one of the four voice_quality sub-scores, anchored to the pro reference pack (10 at the pack median) when a calibration file is loaded.

strain.method: high pitch + above-median loudness + HNR >=4 dB below this take's own median
strain.reliability: medium — heuristic; intentional grit also trips it, confirm by ear at the timestamps

voice_quality.interpretation: Mild breathiness or intentional grit; normal sung-note perturbation; elevated amplitude perturbation.

reference.note: Speech norms are for sustained spoken vowels; sung notes with vibrato run naturally higher. Interpretation above uses singing-oriented bands.

harmonic_balance.note: Global tonal-balance descriptor over the whole file (includes silence/consonants). NOT clinical HNR — see voice_quality.hnr_db_median.

resonance.singers_formant_note: Median 2-4 kHz vs 80 Hz-2 kHz energy on active frames. Heuristic bands; NOT part of the technical score — no pro-pack anchors exist for it yet (unlike CPPS, which is anchored and scored).

dynamics.reference_note: dB relative to the loudest frame in this file (internal contrast, not absolute loudness).

rhythm.measures: onset density & regularity of the vocal delivery — NOT timing vs the backing (see groove)
rhythm.tempo_confidence: low (isolated vocal stem — beat tracking expects a full mix; indicative only)

vowel_space.reliability: medium — vowel identity from F1/F2 is approximate on sung (vs spoken) vowels; excluded above F0 350 Hz where formant tracking breaks down

vibrato.onset_delay_note: Time from note start until vibrato blooms. Pros typically ~0.2-0.6 s; near-zero can read as nervous wobble, very late as an afterthought.

intonation.caveat: Grid-deviation is a proxy: expressive slides, blue notes and non-12-TET material register as deviation. Interpret alongside the recording context.

registers.reliability: medium — verify by ear at the timestamps

breath.method: pitch slope over the final 0.5 s of each phrase
breath.note: Sagging endings on LONG phrases suggest breath running out; on short phrases, intentional fall-offs are common in rock/soul — judge by ear.

range_map.note: Time-weighted from this take only. Compare across takes/songs for a true personal range picture.

onsets.method: first 0.25 s of each sustained note vs its settled centre
onsets.note: Scooping can be deliberate style — consistency matters more than the raw percentage. Compare with the original via tools/compare_takes.py to see whether the original scoops in the same places.

harmonics.method: per-sustained-note FFT, harmonic peaks at k*F0, median across notes
harmonics.note: Numeric overtone profile. On separated stems, separation artifacts add noise to upper harmonics — read H5+ cautiously.

environment_risk.note: Elevated risk means F0, brightness, and roughness metrics should be treated as supporting evidence, not absolute truth.

visual_diagnostics.note: Supporting visual diagnostics. In karaoke/live-room recordings, backing track bleed and mic clipping can affect these traces.

technical_score.capture_fair_note: Rubric with the capture-sensitive components (voice_quality and dynamics_expression) excluded (weights renormalised). Jitter/shimmer/HNR and effective dynamic range partly measure the recording chain and stem-separation artefacts: vintage masters run through separation read far worse than clean modern captures of an equal voice. Use capture_fair on BOTH sides for any take-vs-original or cross-era comparison; use overall_score for a singer's absolute result and self-progress. Note breath_support is deliberately NOT excluded: phrase-ending sag is air running out, not the room, so it is scored on a phone or room take like any other.
technical_score.provenance: deterministic_rubric_v5 — computed from measured audio features; identical audio yields an identical score; no LLM involvement; anchored to professional reference distribution

intonation_accuracy.input: median abs grid deviation = 10.0 cents — matches or beats 100.0% of 50 pro references
intonation_accuracy.formula: 10 at pro-reference median (20.0 cents), 0 at 45 cents, linear

pitch_stability.input: median intra-note drift = 1.8 cents — matches or beats 98.0% of 50 pro references
pitch_stability.formula: 10 at pro-reference median (24.25 cents), 0 at 80 cents, linear

voice_quality.input: jitter = 0.9823% — matches or beats 34.0% of 50 pro references; shimmer = 15.4438% — matches or beats 6.0% of 50 pro references; HNR = 8.04 dB — matches or beats 2.0% of 50 pro references; CPPS = 7.64 dB — matches or beats 0.0% of 50 pro references
voice_quality.formula: mean of jitter/shimmer/HNR/CPPS sub-scores (Praat, per sustained note)

vibrato_control.input: 7.7% of long notes carry vibrato (10 at >=40%); rate 5.65 Hz (ideal 4.877-5.99); extent 20.8 cents (ideal 52.55-78.02); intra-note drift 1.8 cents (straight-tone path)
vibrato_control.formula: best of vibrato-quality path and straight-tone steadiness path (consistent straight tone is a valid professional style)

dynamics_expression.input: phrase-level spread 5.9 dB (pro p10/p50/p90 8.795/21.825/45.739); effective range 12.4 dB (pro p10/p50/p90 18.398/26.965/36.303)
dynamics_expression.formula: best of phrase-level shaping and effective range, graded to the pro distribution (10 at the professional median, ~7 across the pro range, floored not zeroed beyond it)

phrase_control.input: median phrase length = 0.48 s — matches or beats 0.0% of 50 pro references
phrase_control.formula: 10 at pro-reference median (3.8 s), 0 at 0.5 s, linear

breath_support.input: 16 of 105 phrase endings sag = 15.2% — matches or beats 96.0% of 50 pro references

technical_score.scope_note: Technical execution only. Artistry, emotion, interpretation and style-appropriateness are human judgements and are not part of this number. Any 'listener impact' figure elsewhere in a report is a subjective estimate, not a measurement.

prescriptions.method: deterministic_prescription_engine_v1 — rules over measured values; exercise content verbatim from the library; no LLM selection
guards_applied: vibrato trigger skipped: <8% presence reads as deliberate straight tone (style)
prescriptions.note: No limiter triggered — no drill prescribed (exercises are prescriptions, not rewards).

entry_accuracy.not_a_score_note: ENTRY ACCURACY is a diagnostic, not a score. It is NOT part of the overall or the capture-fair number and must never be quoted as a /10 or averaged with one. An onset_accuracy score component was built, tested and rejected in Aug 2026 for making agreement with the singer's ear worse.
entry_accuracy.method: first 0.25 s of each sustained note vs its settled centre
entry_accuracy.reliability_reason: HNR 8.04 dB / jitter 0.9823% is a degraded signal, yet the onsets (91.5% clean) and held-note drift (1.8c) beat 90% of the professional pack. A voice cannot sound that rough and start notes that perfectly. This is the signature of a pitch tracker locked onto backing instruments, which are perfectly in tune and start instantly — the measurement describes the band, not the singer. Re-separate.
entry_accuracy.basis: 91.5% of entries land clean — WITHHELD: HNR 8.04 dB / jitter 0.9823% is a degraded signal, yet the onsets (91.5% clean) and held-note drift (1.8c) beat 90% of the professional pack.
